scope: Hash-verified cached public default-branch rasters of the owner's GEMSDOE repositories (docs/downloads, releases, submission* paths); distinct decoded contents compared with the shared vendor function and fanned out to all files sharing the content. NOT organizer-complete: history, private repos, other owners, zip-only/site-only objects absent; 0 index errors, 5 non-single-band/grid-mismatch files and 1 invalid TIFF excluded at cache time.

blankets.note: A raster whose 3 px halo covers >= 50 % of the footprint is hit by random placement at >= 50 % and by any candidate in the fault-rich terrain at ~100 %; a 70 % threshold cannot identify a lane against it.
